cohort: 280 women (309 pregnancies) with pre-excitation syndrome who delivered at West China Second University Hospital from June 2011 to October 2021
finding: Pregnant women with pre-excitation syndrome who experienced SVT during pregnancy had a higher risk of cardiac and obstetric complications, including a higher cesarean section rate and fetal death.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate was significantly higher in the SVT group (88.7%) compared to the non-SVT group (64.8%).
